letter.subject: Expression of interest: Civil + Water Team
paragraphs: I am lodging an expression of interest for the Civil and Water team at Bligh Tanner in Brisbane through your HR Partner careers page. I am looking for graduate civil design and drafting support work where I can contribute under mentoring.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and as field engineer at Grand Travaux. I have not yet worked on Australian water, sewer or wastewater projects, and my CAD experience is academic rather than commercial production drafting.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional and interstate work and open to discussing a Brisbane base.
I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

screening_answers.Are you authorised to work in this count: Yes. Subclass 485 visa with full working rights until December 2027.
